title: vivo X500 Pro Max display details revealed
description: Another day brings another detail about vivo’s upcoming X500 series. The company recently revealed the camera and chipset details of the X500 Pro models and has now shared information about the X500 Pro Max’s display. The vivo X500 Pro Max will come with the world’s first BOE Q11 panel, the company confirmed in a Weibo post. It will sport a 6.85-inch AMOLED display with a 2K resolution. The new BOE Q11 luminescent material is claimed to reduce motion blur by 93% during scrolling and improve colour uniformity by 43%. vivo also says the panel offers 22% better brightness...

description: Indian handset maker Lava will make its UK debut with the launch of Agni 4N there. The brand hasn't revealed the Agni 4N's price, but it said the smartphone will go on sale in the UK through Amazon starting September 4. Lava previously confirmed that the Agni 4N will have a metal build. title: Google Search's AI Mode can now track flight prices and book hotels for you
description: Today Google is giving its AI Mode the ability to track flight prices for you. This is basically the existing Google Flights feature, but brought into AI Mode in Google Search. You can set up price alerts as you chat. You can also just use AI Mode like Google Flights now, simply describing where and when you want to fly and it will show you the best options available from over 300 partner airlines and travel sites. You can then build your itinerary in AI Mode and buy your tickets through the airline's website or another booking platform. AI Mode will even search based on...

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro renders leak, new design is in
description: Over the past few days we've seen leaked CAD-based renders of the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 and S27 Ultra, and today we’re getting a look at the S27 Pro. This will be the new model in the line, and you can think of it as a smaller version of the S27 Ultra, devoid of an S Pen. The Galaxy S27 Pro inherits the S27 Ultra’s new camera island design, which seems heavily inspired by Apple's iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max. title: Mivi becomes the latest Indian brand to enter the smartphone market
description: Recently, Indian smartwatch brand Fire-Boltt entered the smartphone market with the launch of the Boltt Ace and Boltt Evo. Now, another Indian brand, audio products maker Mivi, has confirmed that it is also entering the smartphone market. In an official post on X, Mivi revealed that it will launch a 5G smartphone in India in September. The upcoming handset is confirmed to be powered by a Snapdragon chipset. description: vivo quietly listed the Y31t on its Indian website last week without revealing its pricing or availability. But we now know how much the vivo Y31t costs, as it’s now on sale in the country. The vivo Y31t comes in Crimson Red, Seashore Green, and Golden Mist colors, with three memory configurations - 4GB/128GB, 6GB/128GB, and 6GB/256GB, priced at INR25,999, INR29,999, and INR34,999, respectively. description: Huawei introduced its nova 16 series back in June, and we now have confirmation that the nova 16 Pro will finally go global. Huawei confirmed the midranger will make its global debut at its upcoming global launch event on September 2 in Munich, Germany. The new model is starting to pop up on Samsung.com and it will be available through carriers and retailers too – but you can’t have one just yet, the official start of sales is on September 4 (Friday next week). title: Google Keep's 'Find in note' search feature rolling out for Android users
description: Last year, Google began working on a feature called "Find in note" for Google Keep on Android, which lets users search within notes. The feature is now rolling out to all Google Keep users on Android. To search within a note in Google Keep, open the note, tap the three-dot menu button in the bottom-right corner, tap on the "Find in note" option, and enter what you want to find. Your search term will appear highlighted in yellow throughout the note. It's similar to pressing Ctrl+F on a PC. title: Samsung unveils curved 49" 360Hz OLED gaming monitor, also a 27" 1,100Hz IPS LCD monitor
description: Gamescom 2026 started yesterday and Samsung unveiled four gaming monitors from the Odyssey line that boast some impressive specs – including one that can go up to 1,100Hz refresh rate. Yes, over a thousand hertz. Starting with the Samsung Odyssey OLED G9 (G95SJ), this is the world’s first 49” Dual QHD monitor with 360Hz refresh rate. It has a curved 5th gen QD-OLED panel, which is 1.3x more efficient than the previous generation while also having double the longevity. title: Our Redmi Note 17 Pro battery life and charging tests are ready
description: The global Redmi Note 17 Pro uses the same Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chipset as the Chinese version of the phone. It has a smaller Si/C battery, but the loss is minimal – 8,340mAh instead of 9,000mAh. At this point we’re used to seeing battery capacities cut much deeper than that, especially on models that are available in Europe. And it’s a huge upgrade over the old Redmi Note 15 Pro, which had a 6,580mAh battery. Xiaomi also boosted the charging hardware and the new model supports 67W HyperCharge, up from 45W. title: Oppo releases ColorOS 16 August update with new features and improvements
description: Oppo has just started seeding an update to the existing ColorOS 16 to eligible devices. The August update brings an AI Remix Collage, security improvements, new Home Screen functionalities, Currency Converter widgets and new Notes features. The AI Remix Collage now has a Smart Cutout that allows you to create stickers or advanced collages with layer controls. The Security and Phone Manager apps can block suspicious app activity on the fly, as well as malicious popups and rogue apps that drain your battery. title: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE arrives with a new chipset and a host of One UI 9 features
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE may as well have been called the S26 AI. When designing this phone, the company’s focus was on new AI features and the utility they offer in day-to-day tasks. There are hardware upgrades too, though pluralizing that word may be a stretch. The funny thing is that when Samsung unveiled the S26 FE, it didn’t mention the chipset – we're quite certain that it is the Exynos 2500. title: Redmi Note 17 and Redmi Note 17 5G focus on big batteries and displays
description: Xiaomi's global Redmi Note 17 family is here and we're looking at the two non-Pro models now (head this way for the Pros). The Redmi Note 17 and Redmi Note 17 5G are nearly identical phones, save for some obvious differences - the choice of chipset and the ability to connect to 5G. The Redmi Note 17 uses the 6nm Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 with either 4GB, 6GB, or 8GB of RAM. Its CPU clocks up to 2.9GHz, and its modem supports up to 4G.
